`rota.plot` draws ROTA results in one call, with the unit, the dB reference and the amplitude convention in the labels. Every figure below comes from the gallery `examples/11_plot_gallery.py`; [docs/plotting.md](https://github.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/blob/v0.7.0/docs/plotting.md) shows all fifteen functions.

```python
import rota.plot as rp   # pip install "rota-order[plot]"
```

**Campbell diagram with order lines** — `rp.rpm_frequency_map(fmap, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, mark_orders=(1.5, 3, 4.5, 6))`

![Campbell diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.7.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_frequency_map.png)

**Before and after on one colour scale, with the dB difference** — `rp.compare_maps({"original": omap, "order 3 -10 dB": omap_y}, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, difference=True)`

![compare_maps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.7.0/docs/images/plot_compare_maps.png)

**Order slices against the analytic truth** — `rp.order_slice({"order 1.5": s15, "order 3": s3}, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, truth={...})`

![order_slice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.7.0/docs/images/plot_order_slice.png)

**Tacholess speed with its unreliable frames marked** — `rp.rpm_from_ridge(ridge, reference=(t, rpm))`

![rpm_from_ridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.7.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_from_ridge.png)

**Tone prominence against the ECMA-418-1 criterion** — `rp.order_prominence(prom)`

![order_prominence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.7.0/docs/images/plot_order_prominence.png)

**1/3-octave band levels along rpm** — `rp.band_levels_vs_rpm(bands, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE)`

![band_levels_vs_rpm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.7.0/docs/images/plot_band_levels_vs_rpm.png)
